title: Project DVito contains DVendo Uptime fleet dashboard; CCTV integration remains a placeholder
summary: The Project DVito directory contains the DVendo Uptime installable dashboard for multiple authorized DITO prepaid Wi-Fi accounts grouped by site. The frontend provides overview charts, account and group editing, spending, team roles and settings; Worker routes implement account refresh, promo browsing and purchase, history, groups and users. The D1 schema stores users, groups, accounts, top-ups, settings and challenges. Production frontend text explicitly states that Tapo integration, camera feeds and availability checks are not implemented and internet reachability has not been measured. The README reports a prior deployment; current deployment health and live DITO behavior were not checked in this source inspection.

evidence.description: Project purpose, structure and historical deployment claims.
Account, spending, promo, group, settings and team API routes.
Site details and CCTV placeholder implementation.

nextSteps: If runtime assurance is requested, validate the dashboard separately; preserve the distinction between local source inspection and live account or deployment verification.
